pure-announcement.rationale: This is vendor setup documentation for wiring E2B sandboxes to Claude Managed Agents, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (W2S sandbox, proxy-boundary capture, MCP/skills notes) covers routing managed-agent sessions to per-session self-hosted sandbox workers.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every claim is checkable against E2B's public template and the Claude Console by following the documented setup end to end.

durability.rationale: The session-to-sandbox router split has some life, but the note is dominated by template names, port numbers, console URLs and log paths that will rot with the next product revision.

actionability.rationale: The steps are E2B-product-specific (start this template, register this webhook), and the ingest dropped the actual commands, leaving several step headings with no code under them.

atomicity.rationale: The whole note serves one statable idea: Claude runs the reasoning loop remotely while tool calls execute in your own per-session sandbox behind a webhook router.
